_about: Phase 4. Upgrades are bought with credits and apply to the whole factory (like shapez). Each track has levels in order; 'mult' is the total multiplier at that level (it stacks with perks). Boosts are one-use and last 'seconds'. Side orders appear in a free dock slot every 'everySeconds', stay 'expireSeconds', ask for something the player has made before, and pay 'creditBonus' times the usual credits. They never count toward level-ups.

overdrive.name: Overdrive
overdrive.what: All machines work twice as fast for 60 seconds.

rush.name: Rush
rush.what: All hoppers give parts twice as fast for 60 seconds.
